_meta.scope: United States: HTSUS chapter 22 general (column 1) duty, TTB federal excise tax at the general (non-CBMA) rate, no federal VAT or sales tax at import.
notes: ADDITIONAL TARIFFS NOT INCLUDED: since 2025 the US applies origin-based additional duties (IEEPA 'reciprocal' tariffs, Section 232 and 301) that change by executive order and sit on top of these rates — check HTSUS chapter 99 for the origin before you commit. The result shows this warning.
Fees not included: Merchandise Processing Fee 0.3464% of value (with annual min/max) and Harbor Maintenance Fee 0.125% on sea freight; add them under local charges.
Excise is the general rate: importers assigned CBMA reduced rates/credits by the foreign producer pay less (e.g. wine credit $1.00/gal on the first 30,000 gallons).
Conversions: 1 wine gallon = 3.78541 L; 1 beer barrel = 31 gallons = 117.348 L; 1 proof gallon = 1 gallon at 50% ABV, so $13.50/proof gallon = $7.1328 per litre of pure alcohol.
Rum: 23.7¢/proof litre applies to rum valued ≤ $3/proof litre (modelled); rum above that is Free. Vodka and most spirits Free. 2208.90 'other' 21.1¢/proof litre.
State alcohol excise and sales taxes are extra and vary by state; not modelled. Not yet checked against an entry summary — tier official.
